answer.justification: Antibiotic-associated foul-smelling watery diarrhea with gram-positive anaerobic rods indicates Clostridioides difficile. Its spores resist alcohol/isopropanol, iodine, and quaternary ammonium agents. A chlorine-based sodium hypochlorite solution is sporicidal and is used for terminal room disinfection to prevent transmission.
